entities._comment_409_h2: #409 review H2, user root-cause ruling 2026-08-09: this prop carries NO sprite. The cache lies submerged under a coat of silt a stride out from the bank -- a legible box drawn on the water contradicts the fiction, and the pond crab overlaps this cell from every approach regardless of what art sits here. Discovery never needed a sprite: the bank-side `observe` foreshadows it, the pond_narrows toast teaches the freeze route, and the adjacency affordance marker fires when the player stands on the frozen strip at (10,17). This is exactly the case invisible:true exists for. BOTH keys are required and they are not redundant: `hide_sprite` is the RENDERER contract (world.gd `_build_entities` / `_reconcile_entity_presence` skip the visual entirely) and `invisible` is the data_lint marker (check_spriteless_entities). Dropping a sprite and setting only `invisible` leaves the entity_visual_factory fallback ColorRect on screen -- a flat PROP_COLOR block, which is how this first landed and what the pond probe caught. Same pairing as boulevard_glazier / boulevard_teahouse / boulevard_cordwainer.
entities.observe: Something square and worked lies under silt on the pond floor, a stride out from the bank. The water between it and the bank is a hand deep and dead still. In the bank's shade the surface has already gone to a skin of ice.
entities.toast: Kneeling on the ice, you lever the silt-caked strongbox free. Drake-work, old, its lock long rusted through. Inside, still dry: a few keepsakes and a handful of old coin.

variants.toast: The strongbox sits open and empty now, holding nothing but pond-light.

entities.observe: A Drake built like a barracks door, spear worn smooth from use, standing at ease the way only dangerous people stand. He watches the road and everyone on it. Including you, now.
entities.friendly_line: Heh. Alright, alright - I like you. You've got the look of someone who buys a guy a drink after. We're good, you and me. Best guardsman in Liscor says so.
talk_pool: Heh. You walk like nobody's ever hit you properly. We should fix that sometime - for fun.
Road's boring today. I keep hoping something stupid charges the gate so I can try out the old Relc Headbutt.
You gonna eat that? No? Shame. Guarding's hungry work, and I'm the best there is at it.
Stand up straight, kid. Best guardsman in Liscor is watching this road. That's me. Obviously.
You met Klb yet? Senior Guardsman, four arms, does paperwork like it's a Skill. Best partner in the Watch. Tell him he owes me a drink — he'll say ants don't drink. He's lying.

talk_pool_stages._comment: GH#186: the post-spar sleep nudge, durable (the victory toast is transient). Earliest-gated stage: every later stage outranks it as the story advances.
lines: You spar like someone carrying something new. Go sleep at the inn — upstairs, real bed. Classes settle at the pillow, not the podium.
Still walking around unslept? The thing you earned today doesn't count until you dream on it. Inn. Bed. Go.
Hah! There's my favorite punching bag. Kidding. The dummies are my favorite. You're a close third after lunch.
You're standing straighter. See that? That's me. I'm basically a [Teacher]. Don't tell the Watch, they'll dock my pay for moonlighting.
Quiet shift. If anything with teeth shows up, you'll hear me laughing before you hear the bell.
There they are. You know what I like about you? You went down the creepy hole. Most people file a report about the hole. From upstairs.
Zevara smiled this week. Actual smile. The warren's sealed and the city's still standing. I'm taking full credit and handing you most of it.
Next time something ugly crawls out of the ground, I'm not even worried. That's new for me. Don't make it weird.

entities.victory_toast: Relc whistles. "Not bad for a start. Go sleep on it — Classes come while you're out cold. Bed's upstairs at the inn."
entities.observe: Straw and burlap lashed to posts, hacked half to ribbons at one height, all of it from a spear's reach out. Loose straw is still drifting off the top one.
Old dressed stones, half-sunk, older than the inn behind them. In a chest-high niche someone has left a charm on a leather cord, beside two worn coins and a dried sprig.
entities.open_toast: You lift the charm from the niche. The coins and the sprig stay where travelers set them.

entities.skill_hint_toast: From up here the floodplains pretend to be a map. Good eyes could read it.
entities.locked_toast: A cairn on a hill. The view is mostly weather.

entities.toast: You get your fingers into the crack; the air coming out is colder than the ground. Behind it the stone is dressed and set close, and nothing moves.

entities._comment: #453 G2 (user ruling 2026-08-13): THE DRAINAGE CUT -- the classless, sneak-shaped way past goblin_encounter_1, and the only Act I producer [Rogue]'s entry can read. Cell (27,24) is Chebyshev 3 from the ambush at (30,23), i.e. one step OUTSIDE its radius-2 band (x 28-32, y 21-25), so the choice is made before the road is in their sight -- and the cut is reachable without ever entering that band. APPENDED LAST: verify-untouched pins prose by positional $.entities[N], so a mid-array insert reds it (the pond_narrows precedent). `once_per_waking` is LOAD-BEARING, not flavor: wi_game._check_trigger_radius reads this prop's `serve:` ledger key (cleared at every sleep) as the ambush's `cover_prop` suppression, so one crossing is bought per waking and the fight re-arms every night. Sprite REUSED from rags_camp_mouth -- no new art, and a turf-cut mouth is exactly what this is. The counter this banks is a state marker; the class-gating counter (`crossed_under_cover`) banks at the CROSSING, in code, so interacting here and walking home earns nothing.
entities.observe: The floodplain water goes out under the wall here through a stone-lined channel, wide enough for a person bent double. The grass along its lip has been walked flat, and not by anything wearing boots.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: You have already used the cut once today, and the mud in it has your knees printed on it. Better to give it until morning.
entities.toast: You go down into the channel and follow it east at a crouch, the roadline above your shoulder the whole way.

variants.toast: You go down into the channel without breaking step this time. You know where it turns and where it shallows out.
